summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd, a Beijing-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (formerly Pheton Holdings), filed a Form 6-K disclosing results of its September 9, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, furnished August 26, 2026. Shareholders approved, with roughly 92.12% of 117,050,000 voting shares present by proxy or virtually, a 1-for-16 Class A and Class B share consolidation effective 12:01 a.m. ET October 6, 2026, contingent on Nasdaq event notification and no Nasdaq objection, plus a subsequent share capital increase to 400,000,000 Class A and 100,000,000 Class B shares and charter restatement. No acquisition, tender, or activist event; a routine capital-structure housekeeping EGM.
